ns2:section.sectionText: Application of Derivative Strategies is designed to build upon the basic options knowledge you may have gained in Financial Derivatives in FIN 512. If you haven’t taken that class but have some options knowledge through experience or via the Market Information Lab Options bootcamp, you can still be successful in this class. We will start slowly by discussing some simple trading strategies that are used by institutional and retail accounts alike. We will move from there to discuss volatility trading looking not only at the CBOE VIX product but also at OTC variance swaps. Finally, by the end of the semester, we will be discussing the most topical options and derivatives structures such as risk parity, risk premia capture, alternative risk premia and volatility targeting.
